name: Eternal Forge
theme: Legacy through craftsmanship: we build what should outlive us.
signature_encounter: The Corrupted Constructs of the Foundation Chamber

stages.title: The Silent Caravan
stages.description: A caravan of dwarven refugees arrives, silent and grieving. The great trade that once flowed from the Ancient Foundry has stopped.

objectives.description: Learn why the dwarves have fled the Foundry.

steps.text: The refugees do not speak of battle. They speak of a cold that came from below, and a Forge that would not light. Talos stands very still, reading the Maker's Marks on their tools.

nodes.speaker: Master Builder Durga
nodes.text: The Eternal Forge has gone cold, stranger. In a thousand years it never once died. We did not lose the Foundry to an enemy. We... left it.

choices.label: [Cultural] 'Nothing lasts by accident.' What did the Builder's Oath demand of you?

nodes.speaker: Master Builder Durga
nodes.text: You know our words. Then you know we do not seal a thing lightly. We sealed the deepest chamber, and the Forge died with it. Restore the Forge -- but do not open what we closed.

choices.label: I will restore only what is needed.

nodes.speaker: Master Builder Durga
nodes.text: Something stirred in the depths. We evacuated and sealed the lower chamber to contain it. The Forge above needs relighting -- carefully, and no deeper.

choices.label: I will help you relight it.

stages.title: The Forge Gone Cold
stages.description: You enter the Ancient Foundry -- not a dungeon, but a sleeping city. Founders' Gallery, Workers' Hall, the Builder's Bench, all dark and still.

objectives.description: Read the story the silent city tells.

steps.text: This is no ruin. Tools rest exactly where hands left them. Bread has petrified on tables. The Foundation Stones, each carved with a Maker's Mark, stand unbroken. A civilization did not fall here -- it walked out in order.

steps.prompt: You study how the Foundry was left.

on_success.text: You are certain now: this was an evacuation, not a conquest. Doors barred from the outside, valuables shelved not looted, the deep stair sealed with a Master's Mark.

on_failure.text: Talos traces a sealed doorway. 'They left on purpose,' he says quietly. 'And they closed the deep stair behind them.'

stages.title: The Great Lift
stages.description: To reach the Forge's heart you must restore the Great Lift -- a masterpiece of counterweights and pressure that has sat idle for years.

objectives.description: Restore and descend the Great Lift.

steps.text: The Great Lift is a cathedral of chain and stone. Restore it, and it will carry you down as it carried a thousand workers before you.

puzzle.title: Restoring the Great Lift
puzzle.description: An engineering restoration, not a fight. Return the Lift to working order in the right order.

steps.prompt: The pressure gauges read empty. What first?

actions.label: Prime the pressure reservoirs from the aqueduct valves.
Force the drive gear by hand.
Cut the safety chains to lighten the car.

steps.hint: A dwarven machine is fed before it is forced.
steps.reveal_line: Feed the reservoirs first. Force a cold system and you crack it.

actions.label: Rebalance the counterweights to match the car's load.
Drop all counterweights for maximum speed.

steps.hint: Balance is the whole art of the Lift.

actions.label: Test and set the brake governor.
Skip the test; trust old work.

steps.hint: Nothing lasts by accident -- especially a brake.

steps.text: With a groan of waking chain, the Great Lift descends. Talos exhales as though the Foundry itself had drawn breath.

stages.title: The Hall of Faults
stages.description: A hall where every failure in the Foundry's history is recorded honestly in stone, so no mistake is repeated. Its systems must be restored to feed the Forge.

objectives.description: Restore the Foundry's infrastructure through the Hall of Faults.

steps.text: The Hall of Faults lists a thousand honest failures, each with the name of the builder who owned it. Dwarves do not hide their mistakes; they carve them where the next generation must read them.

puzzle.title: Reviving the Foundry's Veins
puzzle.description: Restore heat, water and air to the Forge -- in the sequence the Hall of Faults warns is the only safe one.

steps.prompt: In what order do you revive the systems?

actions.label: Water first (cooling), then air, then heat.
Heat first -- get it warm fast.

steps.hint: The Hall records the day a Forge was lit before its cooling ran. Read it.
steps.reveal_line: Cooling before flame. It is the first fault ever carved here.

steps.prompt: The intake valves are unlabeled to outsiders.

actions.label: Match each valve by its Maker's Mark to the Hall's ledger.
Open them in a row and see what happens.

steps.hint: Every valve carries the mark of the builder who set it.

stages.title: The Foundation Chamber
stages.description: The heart of the Foundry, above the sealed deep stair. Corrupted constructs -- once the Foundry's own maintenance automata -- guard the way to the Forge.

objectives.description: Restore the Foundation Chamber's constructs or put them down.

steps.text: The Foundation Stones ring the chamber. Between you and the Forge stand the maintenance constructs -- proud dwarven work, now twisted by the cold from below. Talos grips his hammer, grieving for them already.

spec.name: The Corrupted Constructs of the Foundation Chamber

waves.name: The corrupted core-tender makes its stand

steps.prompt: One battered hauler-construct still bears an intact Maker's Mark. What do you do?

options.label: Let Talos restore it by its Maker's Mark.

stages.title: The First Hammer Strike
stages.description: Relight the Eternal Forge with a single flame -- and go no deeper.

steps.text: The Forge waits, cold and vast. Talos offers you the first flame, but hesitates at the honor of the first strike.

steps.prompt: Who makes the first hammer strike on the relit Forge?

options.label: Give the first strike to Talos.
Make the first strike yourself, in the dwarves' honor.
Reserve the honor for Master Builder Durga.

steps.text: A single flame catches. The Eternal Forge roars back to life, and its light fills a city that thought it had gone dark forever. The first hammer strike rings like a bell heard for miles.

stages.title: What We Leave Sealed
stages.description: The Forge burns again. The deep stair remains closed, exactly as the dwarves intended.

objectives.description: Honor the seal on the deepest chamber.

steps.text: You stand before the sealed deep stair. Whatever the dwarves closed away is not today's task. You restore only what was needed and leave the seal untouched.
Talos sets his own Maker's Mark beside the ancient seal -- a promise that what should outlive them, will.
